# Project Guidelines

## Code and Comments

- Write all new code, comments, docstrings, and user-facing developer messages in English.
- Add a docstring to every function, method, and class. Describe its purpose, inputs, and outputs; state relevant side effects or raised exceptions when they are important to callers.
- Use meaningful, descriptive names for variables, functions, methods, classes, and constants. Avoid unclear abbreviations unless they are established domain terminology.
- Keep functions and methods small and focused. Each should ideally perform one clear responsibility.
- Avoid hard-coded values. Define reusable or meaningful values as named constants, or obtain them from the appropriate configuration source.

## Python Conventions

- Follow the formatting and tool settings in `pyproject.toml`.
- Preserve existing public APIs and project conventions unless the task explicitly requires a change.
